attr.title: Olduvai
attr.desc: The 1991 caveman platformer on Olduvai, a native recreation of its engine. Classic DOS plays it exactly as it was; Enhanced HD adds smooth motion, widescreen margins and sharp upscaled graphics. Switch any time under Options - Style.
attr.inst: Needs your own copy of the game (GOG's Prehistorik 1+2, or the DOS original): copy FILESA.CUR, FILESB.CUR, FILESA.VGA, FILESB.VGA and HISTORIK.EXE (or GOG's PREH.SQZ) into ports/olduvai/game/. Roland MT-32 / CM-32L ROMs (ports/olduvai/mt32-roms/) or a SoundFont (ports/olduvai/soundfonts/) are optional; without them the AdLib / Sound Blaster sound plays.
